sources.name: ODOT TripCheck API
sources.note: ODOT TripCheck data is free but key-gated. Endpoints verified from here (401 'missing subscription key' proves they exist): /tripcheck/Incidents and /tripcheck/Routes on api.odot.state.or.us. Set TRIPCHECK_API_KEY (free signup at apiportal.odot.state.or.us) and this snapshot fills in.

sources.name: WSDOT Highway Alerts (free code)
sources.note: Crash/closure alerts for SR 433 need WSDOT's free Traveler API access code (request form on wsdot.wa.gov/traffic/api). Set WSDOT_ACCESS_CODE.
